headline: Batch 1 of an unbounded campaign, and it does not close it. The ephemeral deployment lane is retired with a named obstruction -- R20 (SSH) and R21 (IKEv2) carry a normative per-key single-use REQUIREMENT for ML-KEM, so M = 1 and G <= log2 1 = 0, and best-of-M ciphertext selection has provably zero room there. The static lane is left open by a NORMATIVE DEAD END: draft-ietf-tls-hybrid-design-16 Sec. 2 delegates the reuse bound to the KEM specification, FIPS 203 states none, SP 800-227 Sec. 4.1 describes the static case as 'many connections ... over a long period of time', so the mechanism's one free parameter is bounded neither by mathematics nor by the standards stack. The measurement that was to serve C3 failed its own sensitivity gate, for the reason the producer found and one more the red team found -- and the red team then measured the missing arm and showed C3 is REACHABLE by this exact instrument.

kill_condition_adjudication.K1: DID NOT FIRE, AND WAS THE WRONG QUESTION. It quantifies over what deployment modes YIELD; a census of specification text reports what specifications STATE. Its branches do not exhaust its outcomes (8 of 14 modes state nothing in either direction, which is in neither branch), and its consequent would have manufactured a 20-bit cap out of an absence -- where the census finds a number at all that number is 1, giving G <= 0, not 20 bits of room.
kill_condition_adjudication.K2: DID NOT FIRE. T4 recorded kill (iii) as not firing and attached a precondition: a Reviewer should obtain 2021/1351 and check the quotes before the verdict is treated as settled. RT-20260806-d008e0 obtained the CCS'21 published version (HTTP 200, 1,832,736 bytes, 17 pages, sha256 2198eaf1...), checked Bernstein's Appendix A.4 quotations at first hand, found them accurate, and reports the verdict 'survives and is STRENGTHENED'. The precondition is discharged.
kill_condition_adjudication.K3: ANTECEDENT FIRED; ITS 'STOP' CLAUSE IS VOID. The 4s gate failed in all four cells, so 'instrument outcome' and 'record no mathematics' are honoured. Closing the goal on a failed control is barred by two separate GOAL-MLKEM-005 non_terminal_conditions entries, and a kill condition may not override the goal record it was drafted under. Recorded as Coordinator defect CE-2.

goal_disposition.criterion_C2: MET, with its distribution restated per CX-1: 2 deployment modes carry a normative per-key single-use REQUIREMENT (R20, R21), 2 are single-use with a named caveat (R09, R22), 2 state one ciphertext PER HANDSHAKE under a clause permitting key reuse (R12, R14), and 8 state no count bound at all -- not the '6 fix M = 1' the census summary and the snapshot commit both carried.
goal_disposition.criterion_C3: UNMET, AND NOT UNMEETABLE. Adjudicated to the NEITHER branch as an instrument outcome. The red team measured the missing arm at d = 100, beta = 30: haar null 1.00116 +- 0.00236, coordinate-aligned 1.09402 (a 39.3-comparator-sd shift against a gate demanding 4), unreduced q-ary tail GSO 1.03719 (15.3 sds), strictly monotone across seven graded points. Its words: 'The statistic is alive; one declared arm was wrong.'
goal_disposition.criteria_C4_C5: MET, and procedural. Per the DEC-20260803-64b55b and DEC-20260805-0b3e11 precedent they cannot carry a completion on their own.
goal_disposition.why_it_stays_active: The stop rule requires C1-C3 to be met. C1 is untouched and C3 is unmet. Four non_terminal_conditions are live this batch -- a lane closed with a named obstruction, a measurement that returned no effect, a task whose declared control failed, and a remaining space narrow enough that a fatigued reading would call it saturated -- and the goal record bars all four by name.
goal_disposition.why_closed_at_budget_cannot_fire: maximum_batches and total_wall_clock_seconds are both null by design, at the user's explicit instruction. closed_at_budget asserts the budget ran out without a criterion being met; with no budget it cannot fire.

coordinator_errors: CE-1, MATERIAL and the tenth in this program: a MANUFACTURED NUMBER. Snapshot commit 7983a474 states 'P1 and P2 passed by 30-100x'. That figure is in no producer artifact and is false for both predicates -- recomputed from results.json, P1 @ 2^-10 margins are 29.3x / 92.9x / 108.1x / 50.1x, P1 @ 2^-16 are 10.6x / 200.5x / 24.5x / 95.7x, and P2 are 290,246x / 268,923x / 359,398x / 403,519x. Worse than the objection states: the string also sits in this receipt's predecessor snapshot_receipt.json and in dispatch_queue.json line 298, meaning I fed the false number to BOTH reviewers in their own cards. The red team recomputed it anyway and convicted the card it was handed. Direction of the error is deflationary, which mitigates the consequence and not the defect.

CE-2, MATERIAL: the kill conditions were drafted in contradiction to the goal record. The TASK-20260805-d23bf0 card says 'if any fired, the campaign closes as completed under the stop rule'; the stop rule closes the goal when C1-C3 are MET, and K3's antecedent is a failed control. Applied as written it would have retired a reachable criterion on the strength of a broken instrument.

CE-4, minor: '5,582 entries carry citation_verified: read' states no denominator, between two properly fractioned neighbours, under a heading reading 'is SYSTEMIC'. Restated as 5,582 of 7,809 (71.5%). Third Coordinator commit message to breach the same caution, not the second.

design_findings: DF-1: a sensitivity demonstration must manipulate THE OBJECT THE NULL REMOVES. T2's null removed the projector's provenance; its demonstration manipulated the error law. The frozen justification was wrong in magnitude and in direction, and the two lines of algebra that show it were available on the day the card was frozen.

DF-2: a gate threshold must be declared in units of the SE OF THE DIFFERENCE at the declared draw count, never in per-draw sds of one arm -- least of all the arm whose between-draw location variance is structurally ~0.
DF-3: a decision rule must partition the space of OUTCOMES, not the range of a quantity. K1 and T2's 4s gate failed this way in a single dispatch; neither had a NEITHER branch.
